# Employee Welfare and Benefits Policy Updates

This document details necessary actions regarding employee welfare and benefits policies:

*   Optimize annual leave processes quarterly.
*   Review and update the bonus structure standard.
*   Update career development guidelines based on audit recommendations.
*   Update medical insurance policies based on audit recommendations.
*   Optimize medical insurance processes quarterly.
